chunks.text: # Annual leave policy

# Annual leave policy
## Entitlement
Full-time employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Leave accrues at two days per completed month of service.

# Annual leave policy
## Carryover
Up to five unused annual leave days may be carried into the next calendar year. Carried days expire on March 31.

# Annual leave policy
## Approval
Submit planned annual leave in the employee portal at least seven calendar days before departure. The line manager approves the request.
# Sick leave policy

# Sick leave policy
## Entitlement
Employees receive 10 paid sick leave days each calendar year. Unused sick leave does not carry forward.

# Sick leave policy
## Medical evidence
A medical certificate is required for absences lasting three consecutive working days or longer. Send the certificate privately to Human Resources.

# Sick leave policy
## Notification
Notify the line manager before 10:00 on the first day of illness. Emergency hospital admission may be reported by a family member.
# Parental leave policy

# Parental leave policy
## Primary caregiver
An eligible primary caregiver receives 20 weeks of paid parental leave after the birth or adoption of a child. Eligibility requires six months of continuous service.

# Parental leave policy
## Secondary caregiver
An eligible secondary caregiver receives four weeks of paid parental leave. Take this leave within six months of the child's arrival.

# Parental leave policy
## Notice
Provide Human Resources with at least 30 days of notice when the expected arrival date is known.
# Expense reimbursement policy

# Expense reimbursement policy
## Submission deadline
Submit expense claims within 45 calendar days of the transaction. Claims must include the business purpose and a cost centre.

# Expense reimbursement policy
## Receipts
An itemized receipt is required for any individual expense above INR 500. A credit card statement alone is insufficient.

# Expense reimbursement policy
## Payment
Approved expense claims are reimbursed in the next monthly payroll cycle. Finance reviews claims every Thursday.
# Business travel policy

# Business travel policy
## Booking
Book business flights through the approved travel portal. Economy class is mandatory for flights shorter than six hours.

# Business travel policy
## Accommodation
The domestic hotel reimbursement cap is INR 6000 per night before taxes. Higher rates require written approval from the department head before booking.

# Business travel policy
## Meals
The domestic meal allowance is INR 1200 per day. Alcohol purchases are not reimbursable.
# Remote work policy

# Remote work policy
## Weekly schedule
Eligible employees may work remotely up to three days per week. Agree on office attendance days with the line manager.

# Remote work policy
## Core hours
Remote staff must be reachable from 11:00 to 16:00 India Standard Time on working days. Flexible start and finish times are allowed outside this window.

# Remote work policy
## Equipment
The home office equipment allowance is INR 15000 once every two years. Purchases require a receipt and manager approval.
# Account access policy

# Account access policy
## Authentication
Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for every corporate email and VPN account. Register a hardware security key or an authenticator application.

# Account access policy
## Departure
Disable a departing employee's corporate accounts within four hours of the recorded employment termination time. Human Resources notifies the IT service desk.

# Account access policy
## Reviews
Department owners review access permissions every quarter. Remove privileges that are no longer required.
# Password and credential policy

# Password and credential policy
## Password length
Corporate passwords must contain at least 14 characters. Use a unique passphrase for each system.

# Password and credential policy
## Compromise
Reset a password immediately after suspected credential compromise. Routine periodic password changes are not required without evidence of compromise.

# Password and credential policy
## Storage
Store shared service credentials only in the approved secrets vault. Never put passwords in source code or chat messages.
# Security incident response procedure

# Security incident response procedure
## Reporting
Report a suspected security incident to the security operations team within 15 minutes of discovery. Use the dedicated incident hotline.

# Security incident response procedure
## Critical incidents
The on-call responder must acknowledge a severity-one incident within 10 minutes. The incident commander coordinates containment and recovery.

# Security incident response procedure
## Review
Complete a written post-incident review within five business days after resolution. Record the timeline, root cause, and corrective actions.
# Production backup policy

# Production backup policy
## Schedule
Production databases receive a full backup every night at 02:00 UTC. Incremental backups run every hour.

# Production backup policy
## Retention
Keep production database backups for 35 days. Encrypt every backup at rest and during transfer.

# Production backup policy
## Restore drills
Perform a restore drill once every quarter. The recovery time objective is four hours and the recovery point objective is one hour.
# Business records retention policy

# Business records retention policy
## Support records
Retain closed customer support tickets for 18 months after closure. Delete personal attachments when the retention period ends.

# Business records retention policy
## Financial records
Retain invoices and accounting records for seven years after the end of the relevant financial year.

# Business records retention policy
## Legal holds
A legal hold suspends normal deletion until the legal team provides written clearance.

# Current device warranty

Version 2026-09. Applies to devices purchased on or after September 1, 2026.

# Current device warranty

Version 2026-09. Applies to devices purchased on or after September 1, 2026.
## Duration
The current limited hardware warranty lasts 24 months from purchase and covers manufacturing defects. Keep the receipt and device serial number.

# Current device warranty

Version 2026-09. Applies to devices purchased on or after September 1, 2026.
## Exclusions
Accidental damage and water damage are excluded from the current hardware warranty. Consumable accessories are not covered.

# Current device warranty

Version 2026-09. Applies to devices purchased on or after September 1, 2026.
## Repair
An authorized service centre assesses warranty claims. Customers must back up their files before submitting a device for repair.

# Legacy device warranty

Version 2024-01. Applies to devices purchased before September 1, 2026.

# Legacy device warranty

Version 2024-01. Applies to devices purchased before September 1, 2026.
## Duration
The legacy limited hardware warranty lasts 12 months from purchase and covers manufacturing defects. Keep the original proof of purchase.

# Legacy device warranty

Version 2024-01. Applies to devices purchased before September 1, 2026.
## Exclusions
Accidental damage is excluded from the legacy hardware warranty. Unauthorized repairs void the remaining coverage.

# Legacy device warranty

Version 2024-01. Applies to devices purchased before September 1, 2026.
## Repair
Contact the legacy product service desk to arrange an assessment. Replacement parts are subject to availability.
# Device returns policy

# Device returns policy
## Unopened products
An unopened device can be returned within 30 calendar days of delivery. Include all original packaging and accessories.

# Device returns policy
## Defective arrivals
An opened device that is defective on arrival can be returned within 14 calendar days of delivery. Customer support must issue a return authorization first.

# Device returns policy
## Refunds
Refunds are processed to the original payment method within seven business days of inspection. Original shipping charges are not refunded.
# Customer support service hours

# Customer support service hours
## Live assistance
Live customer support operates Monday through Friday from 09:00 to 18:00 India Standard Time. The live team is closed on public holidays.

# Customer support service hours
## Online tickets
The online support portal accepts tickets 24 hours a day. Tickets submitted outside working hours are reviewed on the next business day.

# Customer support service hours
## Languages
Live assistance is available in English and Hindi. Customers can choose their preferred language when opening a ticket.
# Purchasing and procurement policy

# Purchasing and procurement policy
## Quotations
Purchases above INR 100000 require three written supplier quotations. The procurement team records the comparison before approving a purchase order.

# Purchasing and procurement policy
## Approval
Purchases above INR 500000 require approval from the chief financial officer. Split purchase orders intended to bypass approval thresholds are prohibited.

# Purchasing and procurement policy
## Supplier payment
Standard supplier payment terms are 30 days from receipt of a valid invoice. Finance checks the purchase order and delivery confirmation before payment.
